name: Stevens' Power Law
description: Synthetic experiment runner implementing Stevens' Power Law, a psychophysical principle relating physical stimulus intensity to perceived magnitude via a power function.

parameters.name: resolution
parameters.description: Number of allowed values for stimulus intensity.

parameters.name: proportionality_constant
parameters.description: Constant multiplier (k) in Stevens' Power Law formula: ψ = k * S^n.

parameters.name: modality_constant
parameters.description: Power exponent (n) that varies by sensory modality in Stevens' Power Law.

parameters.name: maximum_stimulus_intensity
parameters.description: Maximum value for the stimulus intensity.

inputDataType.name: conditions
inputDataType.description: DataFrame with stimulus intensity as independent variable.

outputDataType.name: observations
outputDataType.description: DataFrame with perceived intensity as dependent variable.
